newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA- NOMINAL MONEY SUPPLY RISES IN FEBRUARY.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA- NOMINAL MONEY SUPPLY RISES IN FEBRUARY.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Friday that the country's nominal money supply (M2) rose in February to 5.6 billion litas from 5.5 billion litas.
The bank also in its monthly bulletin that deposits made up 66.4 percent of the total nominal money supply and currency in circulation accounted for the rest, or 33.6 percent.
The bank added that during the month it put 66.2 million litas into circulation by selling US dollars and purchasing them from commercial banks.
The previous month it withdrew 75.1 million litas from circulation.
